<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="accent" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="160%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height=" thirty" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="22" y="20" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="327" y1="16" x2="327" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="332" y1="13" x2="332" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="337" y1="10" x2="337" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="350" cy="16" r="3" fill="#000000"/>
  <line x1="357" y1="19" x2="361" y2="13" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <line x1="361" y1="13" x2="365" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <rect x="371" y="11" width="17" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="373" y="13" width="12" height="6" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="388" y="14" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="67" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polyline points="29,61 20,68 29,75" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="43" y="74" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Settings</text>
  <line x1="0" y1="96" x2="390" y2="96" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- profile summary -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="16" y="109" width="358" height="74" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="55" cy="146" r="25" fill="url(#accent)"/>
  <text x="55" y="153" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">AM</text>
  <text x="94" y="139" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#4A4A4A">Alex Morgan</text>
  <text x="94" y="160" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Edit profile</text>
  <polyline points="347,142 353,146 347,150" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- privacy section -->
  <text x="20" y="213" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#939393">PRIVACY & SAFETY</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="225" width="358" height="154" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <!-- shield icon -->
    <polygon points="39,244 49,248 49,257 44,264 39,257" fill="none" stroke="#EA5D6B" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polyline points="41,253 44,256 48,251" fill="none" stroke="#EA5D6B" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="64" y="257" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Safety Center</text>
    <text x="64" y="274" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Tips and tools for safer dating</text>
    <polyline points="347,252 353,256 347,260" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="32" y1="289" x2="358" y2="289" stroke="#EAEDF1"/>
    <!-- visibility icon -->
    <ellipse cx="44" cy="316" rx="11" ry="7" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="44" cy="316" r="3" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
    <text x="64" y="316" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Privacy Settings</text>
    <text x="64" y="334" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#939393">Control who can see your profile</text>
    <polyline points="347,312 353,316 347,320" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="32" y1="349" x2="358" y2="349" stroke="#EAEDF1"/>
    <!-- blocked icon -->
    <circle cx="44" cy="364" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="38" y1="358" x2="50" y2="370" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="64" y="369" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Blocked Contacts</text>
    <text x="335" y="369" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" fill="#939393">0</text>
  </g>

  <!-- legal -->
  <text x="20" y="410" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#939393">LEGAL</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="421" width="358" height="115" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="35" y="440" width="17" height="20" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="39" y1="446" x2="48" y2="446" stroke="#939393"/>
    <line x1="39" y1="451" x2="48" y2="451" stroke="#939393"/>
    <text x="70" y="455" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Terms of Service</text>
    <polyline points="347,451 353,455 347,459" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="32" y1="474" x2="358" y2="474" stroke="#EAEDF1"/>
    <rect x="35" y="490" width="17" height="20" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="39" y1="496" x2="48" y2="496" stroke="#939393"/>
    <line x1="39" y1="501" x2="48" y2="501" stroke="#939393"/>
    <text x="70" y="505" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Privacy Policy</text>
    <polyline points="347,501 353,505 347,509" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- preferences -->
  <text x="20" y="567" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#939393">APP PREFERENCES</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="578" width="358" height="76" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="44" cy="605" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="44" cy="605" r="3" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
    <line x1="44" y1="591" x2="44" y2="587" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="44" y1="619" x2="44" y2="623" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="70" y="610" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Notifications</text>
    <rect x="316" y="594" width="42" height="24" rx="12" fill="#96E063"/>
    <circle cx="346" cy="606" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="32" y1="631" x2="358" y2="631" stroke="#EAEDF1"/>
    <text x="70" y="648" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">App language</text>
    <text x="356" y="648" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" fill="#939393">English</text>
  </g>

  <!-- account actions -->
  <text x="20" y="683" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#939393">ACCOUNT</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="693" width="358" height="55" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="36" y="726" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#EA5D6B">Log out</text>
    <line x1="32" y1="747" x2="358" y2="747" stroke="#EAEDF1"/>
  </g>
  <text x="36" y="769" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#C42936">Delete account</text>
  <text x="355" y="769" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Version 15.4.0</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="786" width="390" height="58" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="786" x2="390" y2="786" stroke="#EAEDF1"/>
  <!-- discover -->
  <polygon points="38,802 48,798 44,811 34,815" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <text x="41" y="836" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Discover</text>
  <!-- likes -->
  <circle cx="118" cy="806" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <polyline points="114,806 117,809 123,802" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <text x="118" y="836" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Likes</text>
  <!-- matches -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="806" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <circle cx="202" cy="806" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <text x="195" y="836" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Matches</text>
  <!-- messages -->
  <rect x="268" y="799" width="19" height="14" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <polygon points="272,813 274,818 279,813" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.3"/>
  <text x="278" y="836" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Messages</text>
  <!-- profile -->
  <circle cx="350" cy="802" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="350" cy="813" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <text x="350" y="836" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#FE3675">Profile</text>
</svg>
